sn42.8:1.5: Mahāvīra is quotes as saying that a person who “always kills movable and immovable beings for the sake of his own comfort, who injures them, who takes what is not freely given, who does not learn self-control, the impudent sinner who injures many beings without relenting will go to hell.” (Sūtrakṛtāṅga 1.5.1.4–5, Jacobi translation).
